1: // Simple Meteor Escape game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: (function(){
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
6:   // Set canvas size to fill its container
7:   function resize(){
8:     canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
9:     canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
10:   }
11:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
12:   resize();
13: 
14:   // Ship definition
15:   const ship = {x:0, y:0, w:30, h:30, speed:200};
16:   function resetShip(){
17:     ship.x = canvas.width/2 - ship.w/2;
18:     ship.y = canvas.height - ship.h - 10;
19:   }
20:   resetShip();
21: 
22:   // Input handling
23:   const keys = {};
24:   window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true});
25:   window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false});
26: 
27:   // Meteor definition
28:   const meteors = [];
29:   let spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
30:   let lastSpawn = 0;
31:   let meteorSpeed = 100; // px/s, will increase over time
32: 
33:   // Game state
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   let elapsed = 0;
36:   let gameOver = false;
37:   const gameDuration = 60; // seconds
38: 
39:   function spawnMeteor(){
40:     const size = 20 + Math.random()*30;
41:     meteors.push({x:Math.random()*(canvas.width-size), y:-size, w:size, h:size});
42:   }
43: 
44:   function update(dt){
45:     if(gameOver) return;
46:     // Move ship
47:     if(keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed*dt;
48:     if(keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed*dt;
49:     if(keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed*dt;
50:     if(keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed*dt;
51:     // Clamp ship inside canvas
52:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width-ship.w, ship.x));
53:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.height-ship.h, ship.y));
54:     // Spawn meteors
55:     if(performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval){
56:       spawnMeteor();
57:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
58:     }
59:     // Increase difficulty over time
60:     meteorSpeed = 100 + elapsed*10; // 10px/s per second
61:     // Update meteors
62:     for(let i=meteors.length-1;i>=0;i--){
63:       const m = meteors[i];
64:       m.y += meteorSpeed*dt;
65:       // Remove off‑screen meteors
66:       if(m.y > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i,1);
67:     }
68:     // Collision detection
69:     for(const m of meteors){
70:       if(!(ship.x+ship.w < m.x || ship.x > m.x+m.w || ship.y+ship.h < m.y || ship.y > m.y+m.h)){
71:         gameOver = true;
72:         break;
73:       }
74:     }
75:     // Timer check
76:     elapsed = (performance.now()-startTime)/1000;
77:     if(elapsed >= gameDuration) gameOver = true;
78:   }
79: 
80:   function draw(){
81:     ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
82:     // Draw ship
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#00f';
84:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
85:     // Draw meteors
86:     ctx.fillStyle = '#a52a2a';
87:     for(const m of meteors){
88:       ctx.beginPath();
89:       ctx.arc(m.x+m.w/2, m.y+m.h/2, m.w/2,0,Math.PI*2);
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     }
92:     // Draw UI
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
94:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
95:     ctx.fillText('Time: '+(gameDuration-Math.max(0,Math.floor(elapsed))),10,20);
96:     if(gameOver){
97:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
98:       ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
99:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
100:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
101:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
102:       const score = Math.floor(elapsed);
103:       ctx.fillText('Game Over – Score: '+score, canvas.width/2, canvas.height/2);
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   function loop(timestamp){
108:     if(!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
109:     const dt = (timestamp - (lastTime||timestamp))/1000;
110:     lastTime = timestamp;
111:     update(dt);
112:     draw();
113:     if(!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
114:   }
115:   let lastTime = 0;
116:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
117: })();
